basis: Customer-functional paid readiness, not private-core engineering completion.

finishLines.definition: Public raw Search returns a useful cited result through the production x402 path and one external customer pays once.
All six pillars are customer-functional and every master-plan section 3.1 gate, including one external paid useful result, passes.

gates.definition: Customer input, output, error, limit, and provenance contracts are complete.
Production supply is qualified, commercially permitted, cost-bounded, and truthfully identified.
The production adapter and product runtime return useful results and fail safely.
The supported operation is reachable through the protected public API and direct private paths are denied.
Price, quote, x402 and MPP challenges, authorization, verification, post-output settlement, protocol-native receipts, and no-charge replay are integrated.
Idempotency, operation state, receipts, accounting, reconciliation, and artifacts survive process replacement.
Monitoring, alerts, quotas, cost stops, abuse controls, recovery, rollback, and capacity are production-qualified.
An external request receives a useful result through the exact public release path.

pillars.nextOutcome: Operate the verified public preview and obtain one external paid result with receipt reconciliation and no-charge replay.
Refresh lawful three-family supply, build the shared public AI runtime and usage commerce, and qualify durable media delivery.
Add bounded public commerce and abuse policy, secure artifact delivery, and enough production capacity for supportable customer execution.
Secure terms-compatible multichain supply, then connect the qualified gateway to shared public commerce without exposing unsafe methods.
Qualify commercial reuse and history rights, then connect live normalized intelligence, retention, and public commerce.
Qualify terms-compatible EVM, Solana, wallet, and protocol data, then connect public read-only intelligence and commerce.

ownerBlockers: Complete provider account, commercial-permission, or quota interactions only where technical qualification cannot resolve them.
Provide an external payer for the final demand proof; do not repeat the owner-funded settlement proof.
